map.编辑距离衡量「改成一样要多少步」，适合拼写纠错、短文本与近似匹配；余弦相似度衡量: Edit distance measures "how many steps to make them identical", suited to spell correction, short text, and approximate matching; cosine similarity measures "how close the bag-of-words distributions are", suited to long text and topic comparison but ignores word order and needs Chinese tokenization first. Real systems often combine both: coarse-filter by similarity, then fine-rank by edit distance.
